metadata.name: kelpdao-unbacked-rseth
metadata.description: Single-program unbacked-LST replay against the shipped Solana liquid-staking fork. Five stakers stake 2000 underlying each (lst_supply = 10000, total_assets = 10000, exchange_rate = 1:1). At tick 1 the admin dispatches admin_mint_lst(5000) — LST is minted into circulation without depositing underlying assets and without recomputing the exchange rate. The full_backing semantic invariant (lst_supply * exchange_rate_bps <= total_assets * 10000) fails immediately. Historical inspiration: the June 2024 KelpDAO / rsETH bridge-trust failure, where unauthorized mints landed unbacked rsETH into lending markets. Honest boundary: KelpDAO is on Ethereum; this pack reproduces the *economic shape* on Riptide's Solana liquid-staking toy program, NOT a byte-level reconstruction.
